mythology: Sati's radiant earrings (Karna Kundala) fell at this holy spot near the holy Ganga, sanctifying Kashi as a premier seat of the Divine Mother.
pilgrimage_significance: One of the trio of supreme Shakta seats in South-North pilgrimage geography alongside Kanchi Kamakshi and Madurai Meenakshi; crucial stop on the Kashi Panchakroshi Yatra.
historical_notes: Lauded in the Kashi Khanda of Skanda Purana; represents the protective maternal aspect of Shiva's holy city.
